[USER] User requested an example Python program using Extron’s Global Scripter.  
[USER] User specified the program should enable an Extron IPCP Pro 550 control processor to monitor a local variable with two states, mute and unmute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an example Python program for Extron's Global Scripter.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The program connects to the IPCP Pro 550 control processor using the `extron` module and the `ControlProcessor` class.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The local variable `mute_status` is defined to store the current mute state, initially set to `False` (unmuted).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The `toggle_mute` function sends the command "mute off" if `mute_status` is True and "mute on" if it is False.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The program includes a `while` loop that continuously monitors the mute state using the `ipcp.Get` method to retrieve the current status.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The program compares the retrieved status to the value of `mute_status` and calls `toggle_mute` if they differ.
